note: One of the oldest private campgrounds in western NC (80+ years), in a quiet valley at ~2,000 ft beside trout-stocked Panther Creek, which runs into Fontana Lake; on-site trout pond (open to the public), hiking trails from the campground, ~20 min to Bryson City and Deep Creek. --Claude
